What beads are & how to tap them
Move lower beads — count up to 4!
An abacus is a counting frame with beads on rods. People used it long before calculators existed!
The outer frame holds everything together. The horizontal bar in the middle is called the BEAM — it divides top from bottom!
Above the beam sits 1 special bead. Push it DOWN to touch the beam and it counts as FIVE! ✋
Below the beam are 4 beads. Each one you push UP to touch the beam counts as ONE! 1️⃣
Heaven bead down = 5. Count earth beads touching the beam. Add them! Here: heaven(5) + 3 earth = 8! 🌟
All beads away from the beam = ZERO. Nothing touching the beam = nothing to count!
Push exactly 1 earth bead UP to touch the beam. The rod now shows the number 1!
Push 2 earth beads UP. Count them: one... two! The rod shows 2! 🎊
Three earth beads touching the beam. Count: 1, 2, 3! The rod shows 3! 🌈
Push ALL 4 earth beads up to the beam! Count: 1, 2, 3, 4! Maximum using only earth beads!
Push the HEAVEN bead DOWN to touch the beam. Just that ONE bead = FIVE! It\'s a super shortcut! 🌟
Heaven bead down (=5) PLUS 1 earth bead up (=1). 5 + 1 = SIX! Adding magic! ✨
Heaven bead down (=5) + 2 earth beads up (=2). 5 + 2 = SEVEN! 🎯
Heaven bead down (=5) + 3 earth beads up (=3). 5 + 3 = EIGHT! Almost there! 🎈
Heaven bead down (=5) + 4 earth beads up (=4). 5 + 4 = NINE! That\'s the most 1 rod can show! 🏆
An abacus has many rods! The RIGHT rod shows ONES (1–9). The LEFT rod shows TENS (10, 20, ...)! 🎯
Push 1 earth bead up on the LEFT (tens) rod. The right rod stays at zero. One bead on the tens rod = TEN!
LEFT: 2 earth beads up = 2 tens = 20. RIGHT: 3 earth beads up = 3 ones. 20 + 3 = 23! 🌟
LEFT: heaven bead down = 5 tens = 50. RIGHT: heaven + 1 earth = 5+1 = 6 ones. 50 + 6 = 56! 🎊
Read LEFT rod first (tens × 10), then add RIGHT rod (ones). Here: 4 tens + 7 ones = 47! 🏆
With 2 rods you can show ANY number from 0 to 99! That\'s 100 different numbers you can read! 🎉
TENS rod: heaven(5) + 1 earth(1) = 6 tens = 60. ONES rod: heaven(5) + 2 earth(2) = 7. 60 + 7 = 67! 🎯
TENS rod: only the heaven bead down = 5 tens = 50. ONES rod: nothing = 0. Just one heaven bead = 50! 🌟
TENS: heaven(5)+4 earth = 9 tens = 90. ONES: heaven(5)+4 earth = 9 ones. 90+9 = 99! The max! 🌈
Read the LEFT rod (×10) then add the RIGHT rod. What\'s below? Left=3, Right=8 → 38! You did it! 🌈
Understand the concept step by step

resources.string: When you ADD, push MORE beads UP toward the beam. Start at 2, add 1 → push 1 more bead up = 3! More beads = bigger number!
Push 2 earth beads up to the beam. Your abacus shows 2. This is your starting number!
Watch the bead move! Start at 2, push 1 more earth bead UP → 3! 🎊
Start at 2, add 3 more beads. At 5 you swap to the heaven bead! ✨
Remember: adding always means pushing MORE beads toward the beam. Your number goes UP! Try: 1 + 3 = ? (push 3 more beads!)
When your total reaches 5 or more, swap 5 earth beads for the HEAVEN bead! Push all earth DOWN + heaven DOWN = 5!
Watch! Start at 4, add 2 → swap to heaven bead + 1 earth = 6! ✨
Watch! Start at 3, add 4 → swap to heaven + 2 earth = 7! 🎯
Watch! Start at 5 (heaven), add 3 earth beads up → heaven + 3 earth = 8! 🎈
Watch! Start at 5 (heaven), add 4 earth beads → heaven + 4 earth = 9! 🏆
When you SUBTRACT, push beads DOWN (away from the beam). Start at 4, subtract 2 → push 2 earth beads DOWN = 2!
Push 4 earth beads up to the beam. Your abacus shows 4! This is your starting number.
Watch! Start at 4, push 2 earth beads DOWN → 2! ✅
Watch! Start at 8 (heaven + 3 earth), push 3 earth beads DOWN → just heaven = 5! Heaven stays! 🌟
Only earth beads move — heaven bead NEVER moves in this lesson! Try: 9 − 4 = ? and 4 − 1 = ?
When you subtract 5 or more, push the heaven bead AWAY from the beam (UP = −5). Let\'s practice!
Watch! Heaven bead is DOWN (= 5). Push it UP → all beads away = 0! Simple heaven removal! 🎯
Watch! Start at 7 (heaven + 2 earth). Push heaven UP (−5) → just 2 earth beads = 2! Earth stays! ✅
Watch! Start at 9 (heaven + 4 earth). Push 3 earth DOWN, then push heaven UP → 1 earth = 1! 🌟
Subtract 5 → push heaven UP. Subtract more → remove earth first, then heaven. No formula needed! 🚀
Real math mixes adding AND subtracting! You already know both separately. Now let\'s use them together! 🚀
Watch! Start at 3, add 5 → swap to heaven + 3 earth = 8! 🎯
Watch! Start at 8, push 2 earth beads DOWN → heaven + 1 earth = 6! ✨
Watch! Start at 5 (heaven), push heaven UP and 3 earth UP → 3! 🌟
Adding pushes beads TOWARD the beam. Subtracting pushes beads AWAY from the beam. Mix them freely! 🎊 Level 2 Complete! 🏆
When adding would overflow the earth beads but result stays ≤ 9, use the Small Friend formula: remove earth beads + push heaven DOWN.
Try 1+4. Can\'t just add 4 earth (only 3 free!). Formula: remove 1 earth DOWN, push heaven DOWN. 1−1+5 = 5! ✨
Try 2+3. Formula: remove 2 earth DOWN, push heaven DOWN. 2−2+5 = 5! Same net result!
Try 3+4. Formula: remove 1 earth DOWN, push heaven DOWN. 3−1+5 = 7! 🎯
+1=−4+5 | +2=−3+5 | +3=−2+5 | +4=−1+5. The two numbers always add to 5! 🤝 That\'s the 5-complement trick!

If your number is 5, 6, 7 or 8, the heaven bead is already touching the beam! When you need to subtract but there aren\'t enough earth beads — push heaven UP and move earth beads UP to the beam instead! That\'s the Small Friend swap! 🤝
Try 5−1. Heaven is DOWN. Can\'t remove 1 earth! Formula: push heaven UP (−5), add 4 earth UP (+4). 5−5+4 = 4! ✅
Try 5−2. Push heaven UP (−5), add 3 earth UP (+3). 5−5+3 = 3! 🎯
Try 7−4. Heaven + 2 earth = 7. Push heaven UP (7→2), add 1 earth UP. 7−5+1 = 3! 🌟
−1=+4−5 | −2=+3−5 | −3=+2−5 | −4=+1−5. Heaven bead swaps with earth beads! The two numbers always add to 5. 🤝
When ones column is full and result goes to 10+, carry a bead to the TENS column! Formula: +N = +10 − (10−N). Watch the tens rod light up!
Try 9+1. Ones is full (heaven+4earth=9). Carry: add 1 to TENS, remove 9 from ones. 9+1=10 → tens=1, ones=0! 🎉
Try 5+6. Ones shows 5 (heaven). Carry: add 1 to TENS, remove 4 from ones. 5+6=11 → tens=1, ones=1! ✨
Try 5+9. Heaven down (=5). Carry: add 1 to TENS, take 1 from ones: heaven UP + 4 earth UP. 5+9=14 → tens=1, ones=4! 🌟
+1=−9+10, +2=−8+10 … +9=−1+10. Always: add 10 to tens, subtract the complement from ones. Pairs add to 10! 🔢
When ones column doesn\'t have enough beads to subtract, BORROW from the tens column! Formula: −N = −10 + (10−N).
Try 10−1. Ones is 0! Borrow: remove 1 from TENS, add 9 to ones. 10−1=9 → tens=0, ones=9! ✅
Try 10−2. Borrow: remove 1 from TENS, add 8 to ones. 10−2=8! ✨
Try 11−6. Ones has only 1 bead — can\'t remove 6! Borrow: −1 from TENS, +4 to ones. 11−6=5! 🎯
−1=+9−10, −2=+8−10 … −9=+1−10. Always: borrow 10 from tens, add the complement to ones. Pairs add to 10! 🔢
Sometimes you need BOTH a heaven-bead swap AND a tens carry in one step. This \'Family\' formula combines Small Friend + Big Friend together!
Try 7+6. Heaven is down (7=heaven+2earth). Family: heaven UP (7→2), carry to tens, add 1 earth. 7+6=13! ✨
Try 6+9. Heaven UP (6→1), carry to tens, add 4 earth. 6+9=15! 🎯
Try 11−6. Tens=1, ones=1. Borrow from tens (−10), push heaven DOWN (+5), remove 1 earth (−1). 11−6=5! 🌟

The ones rod can only hold 4 earth beads! When there\'s no room for more earth beads but the answer is still below 10, we do a magic swap with the heaven bead! 🪄
When you want to add 1, 2, 3, or 4 — but there\'s no more space for earth beads!
Push earth beads DOWN + push heaven bead DOWN at the same time. Two moves = one answer! 🤝
When your number is 5–8, the heaven bead is already down. Need to subtract but not enough earth beads? Swap the heaven bead back and get earth beads in return! 🔄
When you want to subtract 1, 2, 3, or 4 — but not enough earth beads to remove!
Push heaven bead UP + add earth beads UP at the same time. Two moves = one answer! 🤝
When adding makes your total 10 or bigger, you need to carry over to the TENS rod next door! Think of moving to a bigger neighborhood! 🏘️
When adding would make your total 10 or more — time to carry!
Add 1 bead to the TENS rod (+10), then remove beads from ONES rod. They balance out to give the right answer! 🔢
When the ONES rod is empty but you still need to subtract, borrow 10 from the TENS rod next door! Like borrowing a crayon from a friend! 🖍️
When the ones rod doesn\'t have enough beads to subtract!
Remove 1 bead from TENS rod (−10), then add beads to ONES rod. Borrow and give back — easy! 🔢
Sometimes adding needs BOTH a heaven swap AND a carry to tens — all at once! Small Friend and Big Friend team up as a family! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
When adding 6, 7, 8, or 9 — and the heaven bead is already DOWN!
3 quick moves: heaven UP (−5) → carry to TENS (+10) → add a few earth beads. All at once! 🤝
Sometimes subtracting needs both a borrow from tens AND a heaven bead — all at once! The whole family works together! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
When subtracting 6, 7, 8, or 9 — and there aren\'t enough earth beads!
3 quick moves: borrow from TENS (−10) → heaven bead DOWN (+5) → remove a few earth beads. Team effort! 🤝
